record.narrative: All estimates are signed to the registered hypothesis direction, so positive signed values support the claimed direction. The MSI-high context tests are decisive in the favorable direction. H117, MSI-high among TP53-loss-free and KEAP1-loss-free cells, gives signed estimate +0.766 with lower bound +0.667 and exposed n=81. H118, MSI-high in a clean background free of TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss, gives +0.745 with lower bound +0.666 and exposed n=62. H119, MSI-high within adenocarcinoma, gives +0.742 with lower bound +0.605 and exposed n=93. All three exceed the 0.15 composite-unit threshold, showing that the MSI-high association is not simply an artifact of the dominant TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4 co-alteration architecture and is also present in the majority subtype. I accept all three and keep them active as contingency claims while awaiting independent validation of the broader MSI-high claim H106. H106 is now the most valuable validation target because it is the only major accepted architecture component without independent validation; I request H106 validation. H120 refines EGFR amplification to TP53-loss-free cells and gives +0.074 with lower bound -0.026 and upper +0.173. It fails the threshold, does not clear acceptance, and provides no reason to continue EGFR follow-up; I leave H120 unresolved but closed, and close H58 investigation without changing its unresolved status. H121 tests whether SMARCA4-loss is stronger in adenocarcinoma than complement. The signed interaction estimate is -0.211 with interval [-0.359, -0.063], entirely opposite the claimed negative direction; if reversed, the bound nearest zero is only about +0.063, below threshold. I reject and close H121. H36, TP53-loss by adenocarcinoma interaction, gives -0.033 with interval reaching +0.184; the estimate is opposite and the interval is not adequate for acceptance, so it remains unresolved but is closed. H37, KEAP1-loss by adenocarcinoma interaction, gives -0.063 with favorable upper bound +0.076, well below threshold, so reject and close. The high-aneuploidy interactions are not modifier evidence: H122 gives +0.070 with interval [-0.150, +0.290], and H123 gives +0.021 with interval [-0.142, +0.183]; both fail threshold and are closed unresolved. H124, sex male versus female, gives signed -0.074 with interval [-0.138, -0.010], entirely opposite the claimed positive direction and well below threshold, so reject and close. H29, KEAP1-loss by research_signature_b interaction, gives +0.091 with interval [-0.039, +0.222]; it is not supported as a threshold interaction and is closed unresolved. H77, SMARCA4-loss among adults, gives +0.827 with lower +0.750 and exposed n=308, a large robust replication of the accepted SMARCA4-loss negative-dependency association; I accept and close it. I also close investigation of stale near-threshold or duplicated threads without changing their scientific statuses: H92 CDKN2A overall remains unresolved but closed because its TP53-loss-free context test failed; H20 and H65 remain unresolved but closed because the TP53/KEAP1 interaction has lower bounds near zero and no current path to acceptance without a better validation target; H107 remains accepted but closed as a PTEN context overlapping the validated H80 result. These conclusions remain observational associations in the supplied dataset, not causal or generalizable biological claims.

prompt:
Iteration 8/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative:
The H106 validation response is decisive. The independent validation of MSI-high overall gives signed estimate +0.873 with adjusted lower bound +0.685 in exposed n=114, replicating the discovery signed estimate +0.792 with lower bound +0.676. Both independent favorable bounds exceed the 0.15 composite-unit threshold by a large margin, so MSI-high is accepted and closed as a robust supplied-dataset association: MSI-high cells have substantially more negative composite dependency scores than MSI-high-free cells. The related clean-background and adenocarcinoma-context MSI claims H117-H119 remain accepted as breadth/robustness characterization but are closed now that the main MSI association is independently validated.

H95, PTEN loss in a clean background excluding TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss, reaches its validation deadline with a near-threshold result. Discovery gives signed +0.252 with lower +0.169, while validation gives signed +0.263 with adjusted lower +0.1345. The point estimates are consistently well above 0.15, but the independent adjusted interval does not quite clear threshold. I keep H95 accepted on the discovery evidence and the directional replication, but interpret it as an accepted conditional association that is not independently threshold-clear; further PTEN-context work is closed.

H9, the overall Avana-library claim, is decisively refuted in the validation sample: signed validation estimate -0.064 with interval [-0.195, +0.066], opposite the claimed positive direction and far below threshold. H9 remains rejected and closed.

H35, TP53 loss among non-Avana-library cells, remains unresolved. Discovery lower +0.063 and validation estimate +0.098 with interval [-0.393, +0.589] provide no threshold-level support in either sample, but the wide upper bound does not exclude a threshold effect. Because these cells are small and the broader TP53 main effect is already independently validated, further investigation is closed as unresolved.

The final supported architecture in this supplied dataset is: TP53-loss associated with less-negative dependency scores (validated); KEAP1-loss associated with less-negative dependency scores (validated); SMARCA4-loss associated with more-negative dependency scores (validated); PTEN-loss associated with more-negative scores specifically among TP53-loss-free cells (validated); and MSI-high associated with more-negative scores (now validated). Negative or unsupported claims include the overall PTEN main effect, most canonical driver mutations such as KRAS, MYC, STK11, BRAF, EGFR, ERBB2, PIK3CA, APC, NF1, RB1, SMAD4, ARID1A, MTAP, and BRCA2, the constructed markers, Avana-library overall association, and threshold-level sex, ploidy, aneuploidy, hypoxia, and lineage interaction effects. Remaining uncertainty is mostly confined to small-context library effects, near-threshold EGFR/CDKN2A threads, secondary PTEN contexts, and constructed-signature interaction claims, which are closed as dataset associations rather than prioritized for further validation. The most informative next analysis is the newly registered MSI-by-driver interaction set, which asks whether the validated MSI-high association is further modified by TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, or SMARCA4-loss.

prompt:
Iteration 9/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

I keep H95 accepted on the discovery evidence and the directional replication, but interpret it as an accepted conditional association that is not independently threshold-clear; further PTEN-context work is closed.\n\nH9, the overall Avana-library claim, is decisively refuted in the validation sample: signed validation estimate -0.064 with interval [-0.195, +0.066], opposite the claimed positive direction and far below threshold. H9 remains rejected and closed.\n\nH35, TP53 loss among non-Avana-library cells, remains unresolved. Discovery lower +0.063 and validation estimate +0.098 with interval [-0.393, +0.589] provide no threshold-level support in either sample, but the wide upper bound does not exclude a threshold effect. Because these cells are small and the broader TP53 main effect is already independently validated, further investigation is closed as unresolved.\n\nThe final supported architecture in this supplied dataset is: TP53-loss associated with less-negative dependency scores (validated); KEAP1-loss associated with less-negative dependency scores (validated); SMARCA4-loss associated with more-negative dependency scores (validated); PTEN-loss associated with more-negative scores specifically among TP53-loss-free cells (validated); and MSI-high associated with more-negative scores (now validated). record.narrative: No assessment is due at this explore stage. I closed several active or deferred threads with investigation-only changes, preserving their scientific statuses: non-Avana/Ky library refinements, accepted constructed-signature context or interaction claims, and secondary PTEN contexts are not worth further analysis now that the PTEN-TP53-loss-free claim is validated and the dominant architecture is established. The main open scientific question after validating MSI-high is whether MSI-high is genuinely an independent predictor or an artifact of co-occurring TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4 alterations, and whether PTEN's conditional association is independent of MSI-high. I therefore registered conditional main-effect comparisons: TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss among MSI-high-free cells; PTEN-loss among TP53-loss-free and MSI-high-free cells; PTEN-loss in a clean background excluding TP53/KEAP1/SMARCA4 loss and MSI-high; and MSI-high in a clean background also excluding PTEN loss. These do not replace the active MSI-by-driver interaction tests H125-H127; they ask whether each established association survives after removing the other strong co-alteration, which is necessary before describing the architecture as independent rather than merely overlapping. For broad predictor-screening breadth, I registered media serum as a previously unscreened technical/biological predictor. Higher serum was framed as associated with less-negative dependency scores, with the plausible alternative that richer proliferation deepens dependency; an opposite result would be interpreted as rejection of this registered direction rather than post hoc reversal. I also registered a proliferation modifier test for SMARCA4-loss, hypothesizing that fast-growing cells may show a stronger SMARCA4-loss association, though this is exploratory. If the conditional independence tests pass, they will strengthen the accepted architecture; if they fail or are underpowered, we can retain the simpler validated associations without claiming independence from co-alterations.

record.narrative: No assessments are due at this analyze stage, and I do not register a new comparison because the active untested set already covers the highest-value follow-ups. I request all eleven active untested claims H125-H135. First, H128-H130 test whether the already validated TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss associations persist among MSI-high-free cells. These are conditional independence probes: a favorable signed bound above +0.15 in the registered direction would indicate that the driver effect is not merely carried by the relatively rare MSI-high subset. Second, H133 tests the converse: whether MSI-high remains associated with more negative dependency after excluding TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, SMARCA4-loss, and PTEN-loss. This is a stringent test of whether MSI-high is an independent supplied-dataset predictor rather than an overlap with the dominant driver-loss architecture. Third, H131 and H132 test whether the PTEN-loss association within TP53-loss-free cells survives after removing MSI-high and, in H132, after removing KEAP1- and SMARCA4-loss as well. These distinguish the accepted conditional PTEN association from residual co-alteration confounding. Fourth, H125-H127 directly test whether the validated MSI-high association is modified by TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, or SMARCA4-loss. These interactions are potentially less well powered because MSI-high is uncommon, so I will interpret them cautiously and will only treat them as threshold evidence if all required cells are valid and the signed interval bound nearest zero exceeds +0.15 in the registered direction. Fifth, H134 adds a previously unscreened technical/biological predictor, media serum 10 versus 2. The registered direction is +1, less negative with higher serum, but the test is genuinely two-sided in interpretation: an opposite signed result will be treated as rejection of the registered direction rather than post hoc reversal. Finally, H135 tests whether fast proliferation modifies the SMARCA4-loss association; this is exploratory breadth rather than a likely new architecture component. I am not rerunning tested claims because they provide no new sample. All results will be interpreted as associations in the supplied dataset; independent validation remains reserved for decisive newly supported claims rather than redundant context checks.

Iteration 9/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative: All returned estimates are signed to the registered hypothesis direction, so positive values support the claimed direction. The strongest new evidence is the conditional main-effect set. H128, TP53-loss among MSI-high-free cells, gives signed estimate +0.425 with lower bound +0.328 and n=[382,1488]. H129, KEAP1-loss among MSI-high-free cells, gives +0.844 with lower +0.781 and n=[364,1506]. H130, SMARCA4-loss among MSI-high-free cells, gives +0.840 with lower +0.774 and n=[383,1487]. All three exceed the 0.15 composite-unit threshold by a wide margin and are far beyond zero, so I accept them as robust context tests showing that the accepted TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss associations are not artifacts carried by the relatively rare MSI-high subset. They are closed because the corresponding unconditional associations are already validated and these conditional tests are robustness evidence rather than new independent architecture components. H131, PTEN-loss among TP53-loss-free and MSI-high-free cells, gives +0.282 with lower +0.190 and n=[199,1289], and H132, PTEN-loss in a very clean background also excluding KEAP1-loss, SMARCA4-loss, and MSI-high, gives +0.260 with lower +0.182 and n=[122,839]. Both clear threshold in the registered direction, so I accept them. They support the refinement that the PTEN-loss association is not explained by MSI-high co-occurrence and survives removal of other accepted co-alterations. I close them because the primary PTEN TP53-loss-free claim H80 is independently validated, while H95 is accepted but near threshold; H131-H132 are supporting contexts rather than claims requiring separate validation. H133, MSI-high in a clean background excluding TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, SMARCA4-loss, and PTEN-loss, gives signed estimate +0.754 with lower bound +0.683 and exposed n=55, comparator n=839. This is a stringent independence test: MSI-high remains strongly associated with more negative dependency scores after removing all other established predictor-loss contexts. The discovery interval is well above threshold. Because this is the most stringent new clean-context claim and it directly addresses whether MSI-high is independent of the entire supported architecture, I request validation for H133 and keep it active pending that independent result. The MSI-by-driver interactions do not support new modifier claims. H125, MSI-high by TP53-loss interaction, gives signed +0.123 with interval [-0.316,+0.563] and exposed interaction-relevant cells n=24 and 106; H126, MSI-high by KEAP1-loss interaction, gives +0.049 with interval [-0.201,+0.299]. These are underpowered and inconclusive: favorable upper bounds exceed threshold, but lower bounds include zero and estimates are below threshold. I leave both unresolved but closed. H127, MSI-high by SMARCA4-loss interaction, gives signed -0.181 with interval [-0.404,+0.041]; the favorable upper bound is only +0.041, far below the 0.15 threshold, so there is no supported threshold-level evidence in the registered direction. Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. record.narrative:
New validation deadlines are both decisive. H80, PTEN-loss among TP53-loss-free cells, has signed discovery estimate +0.2586 with lower bound +0.1686 and signed independent validation estimate +0.2969 with adjusted lower bound +0.1677; both lower bounds exceed the 0.15 composite-unit threshold. I therefore accept and close H80. This independently supports a conditional supplied-dataset association: PTEN-loss is associated with more-negative composite dependency scores specifically in TP53-loss-free cells, not merely as an overall main effect or a sample-split artifact. H133, MSI-high in a clean background excluding TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, SMARCA4-loss, and PTEN-loss, has signed discovery estimate +0.7541 with lower bound +0.6833 and signed validation estimate +0.7933 with adjusted lower bound +0.7025. The exposed validation cell is modest but valid, and the effect is so large that the adjusted lower bound remains far above threshold. I therefore accept and close H133. This resolves the main confounding question for MSI-high: MSI-high remains strongly associated with more-negative composite dependency scores even after removing the other supported driver-loss and PTEN-loss contexts in the supplied dataset. These remain observational associations, not causal claims or guarantees of generalizability, and the endpoint is composite rather than a single-gene knockout measurement.

Final supplied-dataset architecture supported by the accumulated evidence: TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss are associated with less-negative composite dependency scores, interpreted as weaker dependency, and both are independently validated; SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high are associated with more-negative composite dependency scores, interpreted as stronger dependency, and MSI-high is now independently validated even in a clean background excluding the other accepted alterations; PTEN-loss is associated with more-negative scores specifically among TP53-loss-free cells, now independently validated in H80 and supported by several clean conditional contexts. record.narrative: No assessment is due at this explore stage. The validated supplied-dataset architecture now has five major components: TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss associated with less-negative composite dependency scores, SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high associated with more-negative scores, and PTEN-loss associated with more-negative scores specifically in TP53-loss-free cells. The most useful next step is to test how far this architecture survives after removing other supported co-alterations, because accepted main effects could still be partly carried by co-occurring TP53-, KEAP1-, SMARCA4-, MSI-, or PTEN-loss contexts. I registered clean-background main effects for TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss in cells excluding all other accepted alterations, including MSI-high and PTEN-loss. These mirror the clean MSI-high claim already validated and test whether the major driver-loss associations are independent rather than merely overlapping. The expected directions are the same as the accepted main effects: TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss less-negative, SMARCA4-loss more-negative. If any lower bound falls near or below the 0.15-unit threshold, that would suggest the corresponding accepted main effect is context-dependent or partially co-alteration-driven. I also registered a refined TP53-loss by KEAP1-loss interaction in a cleaner eligibility background excluding SMARCA4-loss, MSI-high, and PTEN-loss. This is the highest-value unresolved thread: the prior interaction estimate is above threshold but its lower bound is only just above zero. A threshold-level clean interaction would support a positive TP53-KEAP1 epistatic pattern; a clean null would justify retaining only the validated main effects and closing the interaction thread. For robustness, I tested the major driver-loss associations within PTEN-loss cells. PTEN-loss is an accepted conditional predictor, so seeing whether TP53-loss, KEAP1-loss, and SMARCA4-loss remain associated in PTEN-loss co-mutant cells clarifies whether the architecture is robust to that co-occurrence. I also tested the accepted PTEN-loss conditional effect in a TP53-loss-free, KEAP1-loss-free, SMARCA4-loss-bearing background, asking whether the PTEN-loss association persists when SMARCA4-loss is present. Finally, I added two specificity/breadth probes using constructed or technical measures. The research_signature_b high-tertile test probes whether the accepted dichotomous TP53-loss by research_signature_b interaction is monotonic or cutoff-sensitive, without assigning biology to the constructed signature. The high screen_roc_auc interaction asks whether better screen quality enhances the observed TP53-loss association; a negative result against this registered direction would simply reject that technical hypothesis and would not support an opposite claim. All proposals are supplied-dataset associations, not causal or generally biological claims.

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: All newly returned estimates are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction, so positive values support the claimed direction and I compare the lower confidence bound nearest zero against the +0.15 composite-unit threshold. The clean-background main-effect claims are decisive. H137, TP53-loss in a TP53-free eligible background excluding KEAP1-loss, SMARCA4-loss, MSI-high, and PTEN-loss, has signed estimate +0.414 with lower bound +0.315 and n 205 versus 839. H138, KEAP1-loss in the analogous clean background, has signed estimate +0.808 with lower bound +0.775 and n 199 versus 839. H139, SMARCA4-loss in the analogous clean background, has signed estimate +0.798 with lower bound +0.763 and n 209 versus 839. Each lower bound is far above threshold, with valid cell sizes and no zero-inclusive interval, so I accept all three and close them as robustness evidence that the major driver-loss associations are not artifacts carried by the other accepted co-alterations. These are supplied-dataset associations, not causal statements. The PTEN-loss co-mutant contexts also clear threshold: H140 gives TP53-loss among PTEN-loss cells +0.559 with lower +0.274 and n 54 versus 212; H141 gives KEAP1-loss +0.717 with lower +0.519 and n 63 versus 203; H142 gives SMARCA4-loss +0.738 with lower +0.535 and n 58 versus 208. Although exposed cells are smaller, all are valid and intervals remain above threshold. I accept and close these as evidence that the accepted driver-loss associations persist among PTEN-loss co-mutant cells, while noting that small cells increase sensitivity to distributional assumptions. H143 tests PTEN-loss in a TP53-loss-free, KEAP1-loss-free, SMARCA4-loss context and gives signed estimate +0.226 with lower +0.072, upper +0.381 and n 35 versus 228. The interval excludes zero but the lower bound does not exceed threshold, so I keep it unresolved and closed rather than overclaiming threshold-level support; the validated H80 PTEN-loss TP53-loss-free association and cleaner H132 PTEN-loss association already establish the more important conditional PTEN signal. H144 is a constructed-signature specificity probe, not a biological mechanism claim. Within MSI-high-free cells, the TP53-loss interaction with research_signature_b at a high tertile threshold gives signed estimate +0.837 with lower +0.601 and valid cells. It supports the earlier research_signature_b interaction pattern at a stricter tertile threshold, but because research_signature_b is a constructed assay with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role, I accept it only as dataset-specific association structure and close it without biological generalization. H145 asks whether high screen_roc_auc is associated with a stronger TP53-loss interaction; signed estimate +0.074, lower -0.118, upper +0.267 is too uncertain and the point estimate is below threshold, so I leave it unresolved and closed as a technical probe. The library-specific SMARCA4-loss claims are also robust: H68, Avana-library context, gives +0.826 with lower +0.753, and H75, non-Avana context, gives +0.870 with lower +0.737. Both are well above threshold and I accept and close them as library robustness evidence for the validated SMARCA4-loss association. The key unresolved scientific thread is H136, the clean TP53-loss by KEAP1-loss interaction in an MSI-high-free, SMARCA4-loss-free, PTEN-loss-free eligibility background. Its signed estimate is +0.116 with interval -0.093 to +0.324; the point is below threshold and the interval includes zero, so the current discovery evidence cannot accept or reject a threshold-level interaction. Because this interaction directly tests whether the accepted TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss main effects combine epistatically or merely additively in this dataset, I keep H136 active and request independent validation. If validation gives a favorable lower bound above +0.15, the clean TP53-KEAP1 interaction will be supportable; if not, I will close or reject the interaction thread and retain the independently validated main effects. I also reassess H95. Its discovery interval is threshold-clear, with lower +0.169, and the independent validation point +0.263 replicates the direction but the adjusted validation lower +0.135 falls just below threshold. Given H80 validated, plus H107, H108, H131, and H132 near or above threshold in clean conditional contexts, I accept H95 as a supported supplied-dataset conditional PTEN-loss association, with the explicit caveat that its adjusted validation is only narrowly near threshold and should not be treated as independently threshold-decisive.

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative: Due validation deadlines are resolved. H106, the MSI-high stronger-dependency claim, is accepted and closed. Its discovery signed estimate was +0.792 [0.676, 0.907] and the independent adjusted validation signed estimate was +0.873 [0.685, 1.060]; both lower bounds exceed the 0.15-unit threshold, and because the claim direction is negative the raw interpretation is that MSI-high cells have more-negative composite dependency scores than MSI-high-negative cells. This supports MSI-high as a robust supplied-dataset marker of stronger composite dependency, without implying causality or biological generality. H35, TP53-loss within non-Avana CRISPR libraries, remains unresolved and is closed. Discovery showed a positive direction but a subthreshold lower bound +0.063, and independent validation gave signed estimate +0.098 [-0.393, 0.589], which is small, directionally unstable, and too wide to either accept a threshold effect or reject one; the non-Avana cell sizes are small. This does not weaken the overall TP53-loss association, which remains accepted and validated. H136, the clean TP53-loss by KEAP1-loss interaction after excluding MSI-high, SMARCA4-loss, and PTEN-loss, is closed unresolved. Discovery signed estimate +0.116 [-0.093, 0.324] did not clear threshold; validation signed estimate -0.032 [-0.403, 0.340] is near zero and opposite the claimed direction, but the adjusted interval remains too wide and includes threshold. The clean interaction is therefore not supported as part of the accepted architecture; the near-threshold broader interaction thread remains low priority, and the validated TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss main effects are retained. The overall supported supplied-dataset association map is that TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss are associated with weaker composite dependency, meaning less-negative scores, while SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high are associated with stronger composite dependency, meaning more-negative scores. PTEN-loss is associated with stronger composite dependency specifically among TP53-loss-free cells. These associations are robust across clean backgrounds excluding other accepted alterations, lineage/batch/library contexts for the major drivers, and several constructed-signature contexts. Negative or unsupported findings include the overall PTEN main effect, most canonical mutation and amplification markers, constructed binary markers, media serum, sex, overall library effects, most lineage/library/batch/ploidy/aneuploidy/hypoxia/growth-rate interactions, and high screen-quality interaction. Constructed-signature TP53 interaction claims are accepted only as dataset-specific structure because the signatures have no assigned biological role. Remaining unresolved secondary issues include CDKN2A-loss near threshold, EGFR-amplification weak near zero, non-Avana TP53-loss context, and the broader TP53-KEAP1 interaction. The most informative next analysis is the registered MSI-high-free TP53-by-KEAP1 interaction, a broader but still controlled version of the unresolved thread; if it reaches threshold with valid cells, it could support a positive interaction, while a null interval would justify closing the interaction architecture entirely and retaining only validated main effects. All conclusions remain observational supplied-dataset associations about a composite dependency endpoint, not causal or generally applicable biological claims.

prompt:
Iteration 11/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

CDKN2A-loss was previously near but below the 0.15-unit threshold; the expected raw direction is negative, i.e., CDKN2A-loss cells should have more-negative dependency scores. If the signed lower bound exceeds 0.15, this would support CDKN2A-loss as a minor but threshold-level associated predictor; if the signed upper bound is below 0.15, the clean test can reject threshold-level support; otherwise it remains unresolved. I also registered a CDKN2A-loss by MTAP-loss interaction because MTAP is genomically adjacent to CDKN2A, so MTAP-loss could amplify, confound, or independently mark CDKN2A-associated dependency. The expected pattern is that CDKN2A-loss is associated with stronger negative dependency specifically in MTAP-loss cells. For major drivers, I registered several context interactions. SMARCA4-loss by ARID1A-loss tests whether another SWI/SNF-associated context modifies the accepted SMARCA4-loss association; the expected direction is stronger negative dependency in ARID1A-loss cells. PTEN-loss by PIK3CA-mutation within TP53-loss-free cells tests whether PTEN-associated stronger dependency is pathway-restricted to PI3K pathway activation; the expected raw direction is more-negative in PIK3CA-mutant cells. I added a refined PTEN-loss main effect within Avana-library and TP53-loss-free cells because the prior Avana-only PTEN estimate was just below threshold; this asks whether the conditional PTEN association remains threshold-level in the dominant library context.
